rootCause.problem: Inicio required the legacy asesores collection as a mandatory hydration dependency. The seven canonical snapshots were ready, but asesores remained in snapshotErrors, leaving the module permanently blocked at four of five sources.
rootCause.whyNotAuth: Firebase user, product user, membership projection and tenant binding were ready before the timeout.
rootCause.whyNotEnvironment: The rootfix loaded, route inicio was active and all seven canonical collections were attached.
solution: Separate mandatory canonical dependencies from optional legacy sources.
Remove asesores as a blocking dependency of Inicio.
Project advisors client-side from memberships and Equipo without writes or hardcoding.
Use an honest degraded state for advisor leaderboard and goals when optional projection is unavailable.
Audit the same dependency contract in Cliente 360, Polizas, Cobros, Ops, Leads, Conciliaciones and Cancelaciones.
